newsitem.title: USA: Uniforce Services says settles NCCI suit.
newsitem.headline: Uniforce Services says settles NCCI suit.

text.p: Uniforce Services Inc said Wednesday it as entered into a settlement with the National Council on Compensation Insurance Inc and various insurance carriers, terminating litigation pending in Florida and New York since 1994.
Uniforce said settlement terms will remain confidential by agreement among the litigants. The terms will not have a significant effect on the company's operating results, it said.
John Fanning, chairman of Uniforce Services, said the settlement "allows us to focus our full efforts and concentrate on the growth and development of the company."

Uniforce Services is a niche marketer and provides supplemental staffing services in the general and automated office, medical office support, information technology, customer service and laboratory support service businesses.
The company, which has a national network of 31 licensed, 11 company-owned and 103 associated offices, began to be traded on the American Stock Exchange on June 26.
